lineage: Eldorado RaaS (March 2024) is tracked as the same operation as BlackLock (aka El Dorado), which grew sharply in late 2024 per ReliaQuest
summary: Eldorado is a Go-based RaaS advertised on RAMP from March 2024, with Windows and ESXi/Linux lockers built by its own custom builder (not leaked LockBit/Babuk code). Affiliates embed a domain-admin password or NTLM hash in the build, so the locker can encrypt SMB network shares, delete shadow copies and wipe itself. Reporting on the BlackLock name (2025) adds broker- and traffer-supplied access, pass-the-hash lateral movement and abuse of the ESXi 'vpxuser' account. Public intrusion-level reporting is thin; most detail comes from malware analysis.
uniqueTraits: Affiliate build embeds domain-admin password or NTLM hash ('DA' config field) so the locker can authenticate to SMB shares
Custom Go builder with Windows (win/win_64) and ESXi (esxi/esxi_64) lockers
Self-deletion by overwriting the EXE with random bytes from PowerShell before deleting it
BlackLock-era abuse of the privileged ESXi service account 'vpxuser' and pass-the-hash movement

chain.procedure: Access bought from initial access brokers or supplied by 'traffers' recruited on RAMP; the operator also sometimes compromises victims directly.
chain.noAtomicReason: Purchased/brokered access has no ART equivalent; validate with identity analytics and external-exposure reviews.

chain.techniqueName: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Pass the Hash
chain.procedure: Moves between hosts with pass-the-NTLM-hash; the Windows locker itself accepts a domain-admin NTLM hash (or password) baked into the build.
Compromises the highly privileged ESXi service account 'vpxuser' to reach hypervisors.
chain.noAtomicReason: Local T1078.003 atomics create Windows local accounts; none simulate vpxuser abuse on ESXi. Validate with vCenter/ESXi auth logging.

chain.procedure: Windows locker discovers network shares (optionally limited to specific subnets with -n, or skipped with -skip-net).

atomics.note: Network share discovery from the command prompt (local ART T1135 #4)

chain.procedure: Authenticates to SMB shares with the embedded domain-admin credentials and encrypts the remote files.

atomics.note: Maps an admin share with credentials (local ART T1021.002 #1)

chain.procedure: Runs 'vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet' at the end of execution.

ChaCha20 per-file keys protected with RSA-OAEP; skips system folders and executable/driver extensions; adds .00000001 and drops HOW_RETURN_YOUR_DATA.TXT to Documents and Desktop. ESXi builds (esxi/esxi_64) target hypervisors.

atomics.note: Drops a ransom note; exercises note-creation detections without encrypting (local ART T1486 #5)
